where-a-skill-is-stored.header: Where a skill is stored encodes who gets it
where-a-skill-is-stored.description: Claude Code skills in the home directory load "in every project", skills committed to a repository reach "everyone who works there", and plugins or managed settings reach "a whole team" [1]. Codex splits repository folders from user folders the same way [2].

claude-code-skills.title: Anthropic, Extend Claude with skills (Claude Code documentation)

the-skill-scope-matrix-is-an-inference.header: The skill scope matrix is an inference
the-skill-scope-matrix-is-an-inference.description: no published framework combines the two axes into a 2x2 with care levels; the nearest are one-axis tier schemes [1]. Microsoft's zoned governance ties care to audience for agents, not skills: private personal agents, approved environments and admin approval for shared ones [2]. Label the square a rule of thumb.

evals-matter-once-a-skill-is-shared.header: Evals matter once a skill is shared
evals-matter-once-a-skill-is-shared.description: 40 of 98 skills change sign between two harnesses running the same model, so a skill is best evaluated "with the model, agent, and repositories in which it will be deployed" [1].

swe-skills-bench.title: Han et al., SWE-Skills-Bench: Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real-World Software Engineering?

two-questions.title: Two questions
two-questions.script: Here is a decision tool, and it asks two questions. Who uses the skill, only you or others too? And where, in any project or in one in particular?

four-squares.title: Four squares
four-squares.script: Four squares come out of that. Personal and project-specific: write the details straight in, it needs the least upkeep. Personal and general: keep the details beside, it is your own toolkit. Shared and project-specific: the details can live in its supporting files, and the project team owns it. Shared and general: the details sit beside, with an owner, a version and evals. So as a skill moves from your own notebook into the shared library, it loses its project details and gains an owner.

a-rule-of-thumb.title: A rule of thumb
a-rule-of-thumb.script: This matrix is a rule of thumb, and the label is mine. It is how I think about it, so try it on your own skills and tell me where it breaks.
